title: Eight Sleep moment cards
description: A light-grey band with a row of three dark photo cards for particular moments (snoring, a nap, jet lag): one open and wide, two narrow, each with a pill tag, a round + / × toggle and a white caption over a bottom scrim; the open card adds a sentence. A black button sits centered below. On phones the cards stack, titles over the photos.
notes: three media slots, 608×439 open / 332×439 closed, 350×320 on phones, radius 20px
pairs with eightsleep-life above it (same band colour)
